--- FILE: ./workflows/consumer-release.yml ---
name: Consumer - Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Run Pact tests
        run: npm run test:pact

      - name: Semantic Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npx semantic-release

      - name: Get new version
        id: version
        run: echo "new_version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Git Tag
        if: steps.version.outputs.new_version != ''
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag -a v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }} -m "Release v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}"
          git push origin v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: steps.version.outputs.new_version != ''
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}
          release_name: Release v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
--- FILE: ./workflows/consumer-can-i-deploy.yml ---

--- FILE: ./workflows/consumer-pact-publish.yml ---
name: Consumer - Publish Pact (Main)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'package.json'

env:
  PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}
  PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  publish-pact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Pact tests
        run: npm run test:pact

      - name: Get package version
        id: package-version
        run: echo "version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Publish Pact to Broker
        run: |
          npx pact-broker publish \
            ./pacts \
            --consumer-app-version=${{ steps.package-version.outputs.version }} \
            --branch=main \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN \
            --tag=main \
            --tag=prod \
            --build-url=${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Can I deploy to production?
        run: |
          npx pact-broker can-i-deploy \
            --pacticipant=ConsumerApp \
            --version=${{ steps.package-version.outputs.version }} \
            --to-environment=production \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN \
            --retry-while-unknown=60 \
            --retry-interval=10

      - name: Record deployment to production
        if: success()
        run: |
          npx pact-broker record-deployment \
            --pacticipant=ConsumerApp \
            --version=${{ steps.package-version.outputs.version }} \
            --environment=production \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN
--- FILE: ./workflows/consumer-pact-test.yml ---
name: Consumer - Pact Tests (PR)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'

env:
  PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}
  PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  test-and-publish-pact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Needed for semantic-release

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Run Pact tests
        run: npm run test:pact

      - name: Publish Pact to Broker (PR)
        run: |
          npx pact-broker publish \
            ./pacts \
            --consumer-app-version=${{ github.sha }} \
            --branch=${{ github.head_ref }} \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN \
            --tag=pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

      - name: Check if can deploy
        id: can-i-deploy
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          npx pact-broker can-i-deploy \
            --pacticipant=ConsumerApp \
            --version=${{ github.sha }} \
            --to-environment=test \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN \
            --retry-while-unknown=30 \
            --retry-interval=10

      - name: Comment PR with Pact status
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const canDeploy = '${{ steps.can-i-deploy.outcome }}' === 'success';
            const status = canDeploy ? '✅ PASSED' : '⚠️ PENDING';
            const message = canDeploy 
              ? 'Provider verification passed! Safe to merge.' 
              : 'Waiting for provider verification...';
            
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: `## Pact Contract Status: ${status}\n\n${message}\n\n**Consumer Version:** \`${{ github.sha }}\`\n\n[View in Pact Broker](${process.env.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL})`
            })

      - name: Upload Pact files as artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pacts-${{ github.sha }}
          path: pacts/
          retention-days: 7
--- FILE: ./workflows/consumer-ci.yml ---
name: Consumer Contract Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop, 'feature/**']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

env:
  PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}
  PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  test-and-publish-pact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      
      - name: Run Pact tests
        run: npm run test:pact
      
      - name: Publish pacts to broker
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
        run: |
          npx pact-broker publish \
            ./pacts \
            --consumer-app-version=${{ github.sha }} \
            --branch=${{ github.ref_name }} \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN \
            --tag=${{ github.ref_name }} \
            --tag-with-git-branch
      
      - name: Publish pacts for PR
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          npx pact-broker publish \
            ./pacts \
            --consumer-app-version=${{ github.sha }} \
            --branch=${{ github.head_ref }} \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN \
            --tag=pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      
      - name: Create PR comment with Pact status
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: '✅ Pact contracts published successfully!\n\nView in Pact Broker: ${{ env.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}'
            })

  can-i-deploy:
    needs: test-and-publish-pact
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
      - name: Check if safe to deploy
        run: |
          npx pact-broker can-i-deploy \
            --pacticipant=ReactUserApp \
            --version=${{ github.sha }} \
            --to-environment=production \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN \
            --retry-while-unknown=12 \
            --retry-interval=10
      
      - name: Record deployment
        if: success()
        run: |
          npx pact-broker record-deployment \
            --pacticipant=ReactUserApp \
            --version=${{ github.sha }} \
            --environment=production \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN
